clock: It is {label}, year {turn} of {total}. Each build you make is one year: time moves only when you build.
skipYear: Nothing can be built anywhere on the board, so this year passes without a build.
outlookTrack: The years from {start} to {end}. Each mark is a storm, at the end of its year: the dots show how strong.
readiness: Ready {pct}%: your defences would stop {pct}% of the {storm}'s damage if it hit now, and {saved} of the {total} homes in its path would stand ({stars} stars). Build where the map turns red to raise it.
homesAtRisk: Homes at risk: if the {storm} came now, this game's model says it would take {homes}. Each build menu card says how many a defence would save.
sea: Sea level in this game: {cm} cm above {start}. It rises a little every year.
coin: Your Coin: {coin}. Spend it on defences. Your city earns {income} Coin a season, collecting in the jar below.
fieldGuide: Maya's notes in your Field Guide: {notes}. Her tips show the same count. Inside, you have spotted {found} of {species} creatures.
riskToggle: Show risk (R): tints red the tiles the next storm will hit hardest, in the two years before it comes. Turn it off to see the map plain.
mayaToggle: Maya (M): turns her tips on or off. The red warning stays either way.
soundToggle: Sound (S): the storm's wind, waves, rain and thunder, and the game's chimes. Nothing plays until you first click.
motionToggle: Calm motion: no screen shake or lightning flashes, gentler waves and fewer rain streaks. Starts from your system's reduce-motion setting.
qualityControl: Graphics quality: {choice}. Click to cycle Auto, Low, Medium and High. Auto steps down if the game runs slowly (now {fps} fps).
getReady: Optional jobs that help against the next storm. None of them is required.
back: Leaves this level and goes back to the menu.
streetMap: Shows or hides the real Panjim street map under the tiles.
streetMapOpacity: How strongly the street map shows through: {pct}%.
resilience: Resilience: how well the city is holding up overall. Storms that get through lower it.
biodiversity: Biodiversity: in this game, mangroves, dunes and khazans raise it; concrete lowers it.
carbon: Carbon: in this game, mangroves, pandanus and khazans store it (plus); concrete, resorts and homes emit it (minus).
food: Food: in this game, khazans and mangroves feed the city and homes eat. Below zero, the city buys its food in.
population: Population: the people living in the city's homes.
income: Coin your city earns each season.
collapse: Shrinks this panel to a small strip. Tap the strip to open it again.
previewToggle: Shows where the coming storm would hit, as it stands now.
hazardIncoming: Which storm is coming, and how many turns until it does.
buildUnaffordable: {name}: {what} Costs {cost} Coin{time}. You have {coin} Coin: not enough yet.

buildWhat.dune: a sand bank that soaks up a cyclone's surge on the beach. It grows stronger for two years.
buildWhat.sandy_vegetation: pandanus and beach creepers. In this game, the cheapest beach defence: it softens a cyclone's surge a little.
buildWhat.beachside_resort: earns Coin, but weakens the beach against storms.
buildWhat.house: a home for more people. It pays Coin but needs food.
buildWhat.seawall: a concrete wall against the surge. Strong at once, but it absorbs no water and fails outright if a storm is bigger than it.
buildWhat.mangrove: slows a surge or a flood before it reaches the houses, and adds food. It takes about five years to grow.
buildWhat.khazan: a bunded field with a sluice. In this game it holds floodwater and adds food.
buildWhat.small_dam: holds back river water and earns Coin, until a flood is too big for it.
buildWhat.sand_mining: earns Coin fast, but in this game it lowers biodiversity and makes floods worse.
buildWhat.yacht: a luxury. It does nothing for the city.
buildWhat.breakwater: a rock barrier offshore that breaks a cyclone's waves before they reach the beach.

builtInfo: What is built here, and what it adds to the city.
